Evolve the company-wide design system to provide a high quality experience. Share your perspective through hiring, mentoring, and establishing an empathetic design culture within the company. Our stack is Figma, Zoom, the prototyping tool of your choice, and a Slack channel full of lively discussion and fun diversions. We own our own areas, but sit together every day, run a feedback session every week, and hold an offsite every year. Design sets us apart. Scale regards design as a core differentiator and powerful lever in building an amazing customer experience. Join a (really) fast-growing company. Scale is a Series C startup that reached a $1B valuation with less than 100 employees. We’re blazing the trail in an AI industry that’s growing tremendously year over year!
